Title: Power BI Embedded zero-downtime capacity scale

Body.Content:
To remove the delay in content availability when a Power BI capacity resource scales up or down (in the Azure portal or through the Azure Resource Manager API), the Zero-Downtime-Capacity-Scale sample script calls the Power BI API and Resource Manager REST API to programmatically scale the capacity resource with no downtime. 

This means all embedded content is available during the scaling process. It also provides an option to reassign workspaces from one capacity resource to another. Learn more.
